spanish: Si se levanta y anda afuera sobre su bastón, y quedará limpio el hiriente; solo su sentarse dará, y sanando sanará.

findings.issue: H7674 is a noun of cessation; “su sentarse” substitutes the act of sitting and omits cessation.

notes: The other clauses keep the 3ms sequence, niphal נקה, and the piel cognate of heal.
